gates: at least 3 distinct valid source roots
at least 3 independently established source ancestry roots
limitations: Test harness uses synthetic HMAC secrets. Real keys require secure distribution and rotation.
A signature authenticates a key holder, not truth of a measurement.
Declared ancestor is signed but not independently verified by this harness; real deployment must use trusted lineage attestations.
Covert collusion by distinct valid keys is undetectable from these fields alone.
Replay rejection here is scoped to a single check invocation; production needs durable append-only replay state.
